verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in Poly agent that takes natural-language requests to summarize, explain, edit, write, and organize files, including multi-step tasks in a single request. Natural-language search reaches the exact timestamp, page, or frame, and external agents like Claude Code can operate Poly through the official plugin, CLI skill, and MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language agent works as claimed (the runtime probe only confirms the MCP endpoint is live).
